---
title: "Choosing Right Test"
---



::: {#fig-association-test fig-cap="Flowchart for selecting test of association (categorical variables)"}

```{mermaid}
flowchart TD
A[Test of association] --> B[Check expected frequencies]

B -->|≥5 in ≥80% of cells| C[Chi-square test]

B -->|<5 in >20% cells| D{Sample size small?}

D -->|Yes| E[Fisher’s exact test]
D -->|No| F[Chi-square with Yates continuity correction]
```

:::
